**EL-HAZ-1.4.1 Forward turn requests to LIN unchanged**

RLCM_Lighting shall copy LeftTurnLightRequest to ReqLeft and RightTurnLightRequest to ReqRight of DEVMLIN01Fr01 for every received TurnLightControl frame, without inverting, latching or filtering them.

description: Allocated to building block RLCM in RearLight. RLCM is the gateway between BodyCan0 and RearLightLIN. A one-to-one copy keeps the flashing decided upstream intact on the LIN side.
